note: Axis 3 (Liquidity & Exit), single producer. The axis is the worse of executable venue depth and primary redemption. Pool TVL and counter-side inventory are context only and are never substituted for executable depth.

depth.slippage_convention: marginal execution-rate deterioration from the $100 aggregate venue-spot reference; signed cost, with -200bps as the crossing threshold. The dated external USG USD market mark sizes the input notional and is not the impact reference.
depth.basis: The 2% crossing is bracketed by successful Curve get_dy calls across both verified PegKeeper pools. Each aggregate rung splits USG between the pools in proportion to their live USG inventories, preserving their relative post-trade movement; stablecoin outputs are valued at $1. depth_usd is the largest tested USD input notional that cleared the threshold, not pool TVL or counter-side inventory.
depth.bias_measures: the $100 aggregate venue execution rate versus the external USG/USD market mark used for notional sizing; excluded from marginal slippage

anchor.fair_value_source: PegTracker USG backing feed: Curve PegKeeper pool composite market price
anchor.self_referential_note: The mark comes from the same two-venue market, but it only converts USD rung sizes to USG. Marginal impact is measured against the independent $100 aggregate executable baseline, so the mark does not determine the crossing.

quote.method: eth_call Curve get_dy(int128,int128,uint256), falling through to get_dy(uint256,uint256,uint256)
quote.aggregation: USG input split between venues in proportion to live USG inventory; USDC and frxUSD outputs valued at $1

primary_exit.gated_basis: measured_protocol_design: USG is borrower-minted CDP debt; repaying debt releases the borrower's collateral, but the protocol exposes no holder redemption converting USG to reserve assets for an address that did not borrow
primary_exit.gate: No primary redemption for ordinary USG holders; only borrowers can repay their own debt positions
primary_exit.capacity_basis: No holder redemption facility. This zero is primary-redemption capacity, not secondary-market depth.
primary_exit.note: A holder's primary exit is absent by design. The measured Curve pools are the executable exit represented by depth.

enumeration.source: DexTracker live Ethereum contract reads; addresses supplied as hints and verified through coins(uint256)
enumeration.chain_count_note: Two verified Ethereum PegKeeper venues; this is not asserted to be a complete global venue census.

venues.name: Curve USG/USDC PegKeeper pool
venues.depth_role: Included in the executable aggregate get_dy ladder; USDC inventory is the sell-side counter asset.

venues.name: Curve USG/frxUSD PegKeeper pool
venues.depth_role: Included in the executable aggregate get_dy ladder; frxUSD inventory is the sell-side counter asset.

axis_binding_constraint.basis: Ordinary holders have no primary redemption. The $677,124 bracketed figure measures the secondary Curve exit only and does not create a holder claim on protocol collateral.
